statuses.PENDING: horizon not yet reached — cannot be judged
statuses.SUPPORTED: events inside the stated horizon match the prediction's mechanism
statuses.REFUTED: horizon passed without the predicted event
statuses.UPDATED: predictor restated the claim with a moved horizon or changed mechanism (goalpost-move, tracked explicitly)
statuses.AMBIGUOUS: something resembling the outcome occurred, but not via the predicted mechanism

schema.note: This narrative's ledger is multi-predictor: the 2026 sell-off is a live referendum on whether the 4-year cycle is dead. Opposing calls share the same clock — most resolve between Sept 2026 and end of 2027.

entries.claim: The Clarity Act reaches a full Senate floor vote, with the recess as forcing function.
entries.outcome_note: Shortest clock in the ledger — judgment this month. From Coinbase's Q2 2026 earnings AMA.
entries.due_basis: 'before the August 2026 Senate recess' — recess began the first week of August

entries.claim: PMI closing above 55 with momentum starts altcoin bull markets (as 2017, 2020); signal invalidates if the print falls back under 55.
entries.outcome_note: Rare self-falsifying call with an exact date — model audit case.
entries.due_basis: 'September 1, 2026 PMI print' — settles on the published ISM manufacturing PMI

entries.claim: Bear market not over; another ~30% sell-off before the bottom; CBBI (now 32) falls toward 20 or lower.
entries.outcome_note: Bear camp's most concrete near-term call.

entries.claim: Short-term bullish to $71-72K, then a flush toward ~$35,000 bottom right before the midterm elections.
entries.outcome_note: Deepest bear target in the corpus; head-and-shoulders measured move + bear-market week counts.

entries.due_basis: 'Oct-Nov 2026 bottom; Jan-Feb 2027 blow-off' — two-legged claim, judged on the full span

entries.claim: The 4-year cycle contributed to the pullback but is essentially over; crypto ends 2026 higher.

entries.claim: 2027 is a great bull market year; institutional capital (advisors, sovereign wealth, Vanguard-type firms) becomes the largest marginal buyer starting end of 2026.
entries.due_basis: '2027'; 'bull market' needs a stated threshold the claimant did not give

entries.claim: Bitcoin is in a bear cycle now; a bull cycle begins within the next year and Strategy outperforms Bitcoin in it.
entries.outcome_note: Corporate-treasury camp; two-part claim (timing + relative performance).

entries.claim: The 4-year cycle is still intact; upside maybe 2027, with the thick of the bull run in 2028.
entries.outcome_note: Cycle-is-alive camp's retail voice — directly opposes Hougan on the same question.
